title: TEAE overview
endpoint: Any serious related and moderate/severe TEAE

title: TEAE by SOC and PT
objective: Summarise TEAE incidence by medical category
endpoint: System organ class and preferred term

title: Any-TEAE risk difference
objective: Compare exploratory any-TEAE risk versus placebo
method: Risk difference Wald CI and Fisher exact test

title: ACTOT Week 24 descriptives
objective: Describe baseline Week 24 and change values

title: ACTOT Week 24 ANCOVA LS means
objective: Estimate adjusted treatment means at Week 24
population: Observed Week 24 and LOCF sensitivity populations
method: ANCOVA with treatment and centred baseline

title: ACTOT Week 24 ANCOVA contrasts
objective: Compare active treatment with placebo at Week 24
population: Observed Week 24 and LOCF sensitivity populations

title: ACTOT MMRM LS means
objective: Estimate adjusted ACTOT change by treatment and visit
method: REML MMRM with unstructured covariance and Satterthwaite df

title: ACTOT MMRM contrasts
objective: Compare active treatment with placebo by visit
method: Visit-specific MMRM contrasts with unstructured covariance

title: ACTOT MMRM covariance sensitivity
method: Unstructured versus heterogeneous AR(1) MMRM contrasts

title: MMRM model diagnostics
method: Log likelihood AIC and BIC by covariance model

title: Week 24 MMRM versus ANCOVA
objective: Compare longitudinal and Week 24-only estimates diagnostically
method: Side-by-side MMRM and observed-case ANCOVA contrasts

title: ACTOT missingness by visit
objective: Describe observed and missing ACTOT by arm and scheduled visit
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT

title: Week 24 missingness by disposition
objective: Describe recorded disposition context among subjects missing Week 24 ACTOT
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT and missing Week 24 ACTOT
method: Counts and percentages of missing subjects by disposition category

title: ACTOT fixed-delta MNAR sensitivity
objective: Stress the primary Week 24 MMRM contrast under fixed location shifts for missing outcomes
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT
method: Fixed-delta pattern-mixture mean-shift diagnostic across three adverse scenarios

title: ACTOT directional tipping points
objective: Quantify the adverse delta required for each active-versus-placebo point estimate to reach zero
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT
method: Analytic direction-of-effect tipping point with grid bracketing
